{{Quote|You don't realize what you've done.|The impostor's last words, spoken to Han Solo|<ref name="RF: Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref>}}
This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''impostor''' of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]] was used in Soresh's deceptions against the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] landed near Soresh's compound in the [[Sixela system/Legends|Sixela system]], this man was there to meet them. He was used to stand in for Soresh, who wanted to trap [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after [[Mission to Nyemari|contacting Skywalker]] on [[Nyemari]]. Soresh had captured a [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|colony vessel]] and took its passengers hostage, threatening to execute them if Skywalker did not arrive.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

When the Rebels landed on Soresh's [[Unidentified dead red moon|barren moon]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] disembarked from the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. He met the hooded impostor, presuming it to be the real Soresh. The impostor asked for Skywalker. Solo ambiguously replied that Skywalker may or may not be on the ''Falcon.'' As he spoke, two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] strafed the compound. When the impostor tried to blame Solo for the coming execution of the hostages, he brandished a [[Triple blaster/Legends|triple blaster]]. Solo [[Death/Legends|shot]] the impostor in response. The impostor's blaster went off while his body landed in the dust a few [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

After the X-wings landed, a series of [[Mine/Legends|mines]] started exploding among the hostages. The Rebels rushed to help them. Skywalker was accosted by a hostage, who revealed himself as the real Soresh when he hit Skywalker with a [[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]], capturing him and his companions.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown how Soresh was able to use an impostor, but he was probably [[Project Omega|drugged]] through the use of chemicals Soresh frequently used to control his servants. The impostor's first and only appearance was in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book, ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.<ref name="RF: Uprising" />
